These original solid-color GIFs are generated by `GifPipelineTests` in
`Tests/ScriptWidgetRuntimeTests/RuntimeUnitTests.swift` with Apple ImageIO.
`sample.gif` has two frames with 0.1/0.2 second delays; `many-frames.gif` has
61 frames to exercise first-frame resource fallback. They contain no user assets.
Regenerate with `TEST_RUNNER_SCRIPTWIDGET_EXPORT_GIF` set for the native test host.
